independence: Separate @Test per supplemental shot; do not put appearance behind a failing typing recording. Per-shot state restore in finally; failed startup must not abort unrelated test methods.

dependency_gate.host: Existing aggregate preflight: official Ubuntu ffmpeg/ffprobe + acl, JDK17, Python stdlib, SDK platform36/build-tools35+36, API35 Google x86_64 image with ARM64 translation, emulator native libs, NDK27/CMake3.22.1, product fonts/emoji/EN-FR-DE dictionaries, disk budget. No new Python package.
dependency_gate.guest: sh, screenrecord AVC, screencap PNG, stat, cat (/proc/PID/stat readable), kill -INT, mkdir, rm, cp, settings/cmd/ime/am/pm/input, UID2000. Existing AVC/PNG decode smoke remains required. App/Link handlers and locale dictionaries must be checked before their shots. Probe /proc/self/stat state/starttime readability before product capture; aggregate failure rather than waiting for individual takes.
dependency_gate.export: Keep existing strict container validation, full FFmpeg decode, frame count/duration checks, original-byte hashes, per-action JSON flags and visual review. Add only exact supplemental filenames to export allowlist during implementation. Use verified connector file-reference-to-editor materialization route; never raw download URL in producer.

uncovered_runtime: Supplemental class implemented locally, not executed on Android. Hardware sensor/haptic/audio/performance claims excluded. Optional model unavailable/off. Browser onboarding or unresolved safe handler can fail only Link/App shot, without hiding remaining independent tests.

workflow_plan.trigger: Exactly one owner-created branch push; created=true; attempt1; exact owner/repository/ref; no dispatch or reruns
workflow_plan.bounds: 45-minute job;32-minute grant phase;10-minute boot;20-minute instrumentation;60-second recorder per shot
workflow_plan.delivery: Native GitHub artifact file reference -> editor Library prepare_materialize -> attributes/hash/CRC; no raw artifact URL in worker
workflow_plan.publication: Local configuration only; do not publish or execute without fresh specific owner approval. Branch availability remains unverified remotely.
